messages.text: Good, I am just testing out this patchbay voice app to see how well it connects to my repo. I'm going to do a demo soon, so for the next few messages, make sure your responses are super short, just so I can show that it is working.
Got it, keeping replies short for your demo. Ready when you are.
Alright, I'm doing the demo now, but I have this idea of what if we come up with a skill to make really good app names, help me think through what that would look like.

Sure — it could be a skill that combines naming conventions with your existing app catalog, like checking bundle ID availability, trademark sanity, and naming style from the apple-release and app-store-listing skills. Want me to sketch out a quick draft of its structure now, or just keep it as a topic for after the demo?
I only have a few seconds left, so just make a note about this demo idea, and I will check it out later in the repo.
Done — saved as app-name-skill-idea in the patchbay docs. Check it out later.

rationale: Persist the user’s brevity preference, brainstorm, then save a note only on request.
promotion_requirements: Needs multi-turn replay and plugin fixture; also illustrates an unnecessary follow-up offer.
